page.layout: Top: running head "PARS SECVNDA." with page number 237 at right. Below: two round portrait medallions side by side, each with an inscription around its rim (left: BOR. / CAROL. DVX.; right: LEVA. / ANTONIVS DE). Below them: one text column in two paragraphs. At the foot: a decorative ornament, no text.

main_text.p: CAROLUS Borbonij Dux, Comitis Gilberti à Monte-pēserio filius,Janam Ducatus Borbonij hęredem unicam,duxit uxorem:hunc Gilbertum præfectum Neapoli reliquit Carolus octauus.Porrò Carolus eius filius Magister equitum , seu Con-nestabilis , à Francisco Valesio creatus est anno à Christo nato 1516. Fuit quidem princeps hic magnanimus ac bellicosus , sed qui ob factionem quandam ad Imperatorem deficiens,cladem patriænon minimam attulit:tandémque in expugnatione Romæ occisus est. Nam ipsi stanti in scalis , globusænej[?] tormenti parum caute à suis emissus(ut est plena periculi eiu,[?] generis armorum tractatio)crus alterum sub femore perfregit, quo ex vulnere post unum atque alterum diem , animam exhalauit. Vide Chron. Regum Franc. & re. memor.Paral.

ANTONIUS Leva,Mediolano primùm,deinde expediti-oni Cæsarianæ præfectus , cùm paralysi laboraret, in cathedra sedens circumferebatur:industrius quidē ille , ac in rebus bellicis arte Pelasga, quasi alter Sinon instructissimus. Moritur præ dolore uani ac casi in Massiliam conatus:cùm eius spe potiunde , à Melforum Principe ad eam recipiendā ex Italia prudenter ac callidè euocatus esset:nempe ea arte ut in Taurinũ susce-ptam ab ipso expeditionem auerteret,anno à Christo Seruato-re nato 1535.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions are transcribed as they stand around each rim; the ordering around the circle is reconstructed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "globusænej" (the final letters of the ænej group are unclear) and "eiu," (the final letter is uncertain).
